title: Round 762 (F1068): bootstrap vs shipped-data availability + chunk1 value domain measured - (a) 140 existence checks (70 libs x wil+wix, case-insensitive, Windows-like): 54 present / 86 MISSING: root group ALL 14 present; Wood 8/14 (missing tiles30c/smtilesc/cliffsc/furnituresc/object1c/object2c); Sand 5/14; Forest & Snow dirs use a RENAMED family without the c suffix (Tiles/Tiles30/tiles5/Walls/Cliffs/Dungeons/Houses/SmObjects/SmTiles/furnitures/inners/Animations) -> 0/14 by exe names - i.e. the shipped EI 3.0 pack cannot fully serve the exe's hardcoded bootstrap; failed opens leave libs zero and the 0x466640 ret 0 path skips those blits (graceful degradation) [INFERENCE]; (b) chunk1 value domain over 114 valid 14B-cell maps (1.85M cells): v in {0,1,2,15,30,255}: 0/1/2 = root-group tile layers (v=1 dominant 1.27M cells), 255 = none-sentinel (393 cells, skipped by the cmp 0x45 gate - gate purpose CONFIRMED), frames word: 1846227 valid vs 387 0xFFFF-empty; (c) group-byte correlation: byte-0 maps reference cross-group value 15 (in 14-27 Wood range) x4 maps, byte-1 maps reference value 30 (in 28-41 Sand range) x8 maps - every non-tile-layer reference falls INSIDE the (byte+1) group range -> F1067 group mapping EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED both directions; only bytes 0/1 occur in the 544-map corpus (Forest/Snow groups never selected)
objective: Empirically validate bootstrap names against shipped data and chunk1 semantics against real cells.

method: Case-insensitive existence sweep of Data/ tree (140 checks); parse chunk1 of 114 valid maps, tally value domain + frame words; correlate cross-group values with header group byte.
